request.description: Filters apply to the complete SQLite history. Optionally add severity and from/until (UTC Unix seconds, end exclusive). Reuse through from the first response while paging.

exec: pm.test('Filtered alert page', () => {const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.size).to.eql(10);pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(1);pm.expect(d.total).to.be.a('number');pm.expect(d.alerts.every(a => a.category==='network' && a.resolved===false && a.read===false)).to.eql(true);});
